data.content: For each species group (algae, crustacean, fish), which countries have the highest number of site-year-quarter events with a  sumTU > 1 (acute mixture toxicity)?

args.query: For each species group (algae, crustacean, fish), identify the country (or countries if tied) with the highest number of site–year–quarter events where sumTU > 1 (acute mixture toxicity). Return species_group, country, event_count, and indicate ties if applicable.

data.content:
The results comprise 3 rows:
            
            <data>
            {"species_group":{"0":"algae","1":"crustacean","2":"fish"},"country":{"0":"Sweden","1":"France","2":"Netherlands"},"event_count":{"0":159,"1":586,"2":54},"is_tie":{"0":false,"1":false,"2":false}}
            </data>
            
            Provide the user with a Markdown formatted table of the data and a textual summary.
            <summary>
            {"species_group":{"count":3,"unique":3,"top":"algae","freq":1,"mean":null,"std":null,"min":null,"25%":null,"50%":null,"75%":null,"max":null},"country":{"count":3,"unique":3,"top":"Sweden","freq":1,"mean":null,"std":null,"min":null,"25%":null,"50%":null,"75%":null,"max":null},"event_count":{"count":3.0,"unique":null,"top":null,"freq":null,"mean":266.3333333333,"std":281.7735497404,"min":54.0,"25%":106.5,"50%":159.0,"75%":372.5,"max":586.0},"is_tie":{"count":3,"unique":1,"top":false,"freq":3,"mean":null,"std":null,"min":null,"25%":null,"50%":null,"75%":null,"max":null}}
            </summary>
            
            Always provide the following cypher query as code to the user
            ``` 
            MATCH (l:Site)-[r:SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON]->(s:Species)
WHERE r.sumTU > 1 AND s.name IN ['algae','crustacean','fish']
WITH s.name AS species_group, l.country AS country, l.name AS site_name, r.year AS year, r.quarter AS quarter
WITH species_group, country, COUNT(DISTINCT site_name + '|' + toString(year) + '|' + toString(quarter)) AS event_count
WITH species_group, max(event_count) AS max_count, collect({country: country, event_count: event_count}) AS rows
WITH species_group, max_count, [x IN rows WHERE x.event_count = max_count | x.country] AS top_countries
UNWIND top_countries AS country
WITH species_group, country, max_count AS event_count, size(top_countries) AS tie_count
RETURN species_group, country, event_count, CASE WHEN tie_count > 1 THEN true ELSE false END AS is_tie
ORDER BY species_group, country
            ```
            
            Always provide the Zenodo link `https://zenodo.org/records/14616124` of the docker container holding

data.content:
Here are the countries with the highest number of site–year–quarter events where sumTU > 1 (acute mixture toxicity), by species group:

- Algae: Sweden — 159 events (no ties)
- Crustacean: France — 586 events (no ties)
- Fish: Netherlands — 54 events (no ties)

Reproducibility (Cypher query used, plain text):
MATCH (l:Site)-[r:SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON]->(s:Species)
WHERE r.sumTU > 1 AND s.name IN ['algae','crustacean','fish']
WITH s.name AS species_group, l.country AS country, l.name AS site_name, r.year AS year, r.quarter AS quarter
WITH species_group, country, COUNT(DISTINCT site_name + '|' + toString(year) + '|' + toString(quarter)) AS event_count
WITH species_group, max(event_count) AS max_count, collect({country: country, event_count: event_count}) AS rows
WITH species_group, max_count, [x IN rows WHERE x.event_count = max_count | x.country] AS top_countries
UNWIND top_countries AS country
WITH species_group, country, max_count AS event_count, size(top_countries) AS tie_count
RETURN species_group, country, event_count, CASE WHEN tie_count > 1 THEN true ELSE false END AS is_tie
ORDER BY species_group, country

Access to the full Neo4j graph and results: https://zenodo.org/records/14616124
